overall: The low-poly 3D style is mostly consistent except for a more textured look in shot 2, while the third-person view is inconsistent because the framing frequently cuts off the man's legs or omits him entirely in the final shot. The biggest weakness is that every shot repeats the exact same container-alley setting with garbled, out-of-sync floating text rather than visually enacting the rich imagery of the spoken lines.
